topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I wandered through the familiar streets, the soft hum of the city blending with my thoughts. It was one of those days where the world seemed to open its hands, offering small, lovely surprises. I had just stepped out to buy a book when a message from Alex, my online friend for years, popped up. "Guess what? I live in this city too," it read. I traced the path back home, the streets seeming a bit tighter, a bit friendlier. It was as if the city itself was smiling, all the corners and alleys I knew intimately now laced with a new, warm possibility. I thought about how we'd meet, maybe share a coffee, the years of virtual conversations folding seamlessly into real air, real time.
